data.name: Gwenette
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Welsh name Gwenhwyfar, meaning 'fair one, white, or pure'. In Arthurian legend, Gwenhwyfar was the wife of King Arthur and was renowned for her great beauty. The name gained popularity in England during the Middle Ages.
